title: https://truststore.readthedocs.io/en/latest/#using-truststore-with-requests causes recursion error
body:
Running according to docs:
```
$ python
Python 3.10.16 (main, Jan  9 2025, 16:58:26) [Clang 18.1.6 (https://github.com/llvm/llvm-project.git llvmorg-18.1.6-0-g1118c2 on freebsd13
Type "help", "copyright", "credits" or "license" for more information.
>>> import requests
>>> import truststore
>>> truststore.inject_into_ssl()
>>> resp = requests.request("GET", "https://indocs.innomotics.net")
Traceback (most recent call last):
  File "<stdin>", line 1, in <module>
  File "/net/home/osipovmi/.local/lib/python3.10/site-packages/requests/api.py", line 59, in request
    return session.request(method=method, url=url, **kwargs)
  File "/net/home/osipovmi/.local/lib/python3.10/site-packages/requests/sessions.py", line 589, in request
    resp = self.send(prep, **send_kwargs)
  File "/net/home/osipovmi/.local/lib/python3.10/site-packages/requests/sessions.py", line 703, in send
    r = adapter.send(request, **kwargs)
  File "/net/home/osipovmi/.local/lib/python3.10/site-packages/requests/adapters.py", line 667, in send
    resp = conn.urlopen(
  File "/net/home/osipovmi/.local/lib/python3.10/site-packages/urllib3/connectionpool.py", line 789, in urlopen
    response = self._make_request(
  File "/net/home/osipovmi/.local/lib/python3.10/site-packages/urllib3/connectionpool.py", line 466, in _make_request
    self._validate_conn(conn)
  File "/net/home/osipovmi/.local/lib/python3.10/site-packages/urllib3/connectionpool.py", line 1095, in _validate_conn
    conn.connect()
  File "/net/home/osipovmi/.local/lib/python3.10/site-packages/urllib3/connection.py", line 730, in connect
    sock_and_verified = _ssl_wrap_socket_and_match_hostname(
  File "/net/home/osipovmi/.local/lib/python3.10/site-packages/urllib3/connection.py", line 871, in _ssl_wrap_socket_and_match_hostname
    context.verify_mode = resolve_cert_reqs(cert_reqs)
  File "/usr/local/lib/python3.10/ssl.py", line 738, in verify_mode
    super(SSLContext, SSLContext).verify_mode.__set__(self, value)
  File "/usr/local/lib/python3.10/ssl.py", line 738, in verify_mode
    super(SSLContext, SSLContext).verify_mode.__set__(self, value)
  File "/usr/local/lib/python3.10/ssl.py", line 738, in verify_mode
    super(SSLContext, SSLContext).verify_mode.__set__(self, value)
  [Previous line repeated 492 more times]
RecursionError: maximum recursion depth exceeded
>>> quit()
```
but switch makes it run:
```
$ python
Python 3.10.16 (main, Jan  9 2025, 16:58:26) [Clang 18.1.6 (https://github.com/llvm/llvm-project.git llvmorg-18.1.6-0-g1118c2 on freebsd13
Type "help", "copyright", "credits" or "license" for more information.
>>> import truststore
>>> truststore.inject_into_ssl()
>>> import requests
>>> resp = requests.request("GET", "https://indocs.innomotics.net")
>>> resp
<Response [200]>
```
A bug or wrong docs?
